newsitem.title: USA: Versar wins $3 mln five-year contract.
newsitem.headline: Versar wins $3 mln five-year contract.

text.p: Versar Inc said Tuesday it signed a contract with the U.S. Army Construction Engineering Research Laboratories in Champaign, Ill., to provide technical research and engineering services in support of the Army's pollution abatement and prevention initiatives.
The contract is valued at $3 million over a five-year period, Versar said.

The Army wants to identify and to develop environmental pollution abatement and prevention technologies to meet its goals for pollution prevention through source reduction, waste minimization and compliance with applicable federal and state regulations and executive orders, Versar said.
This research will include treatment technologies for wastewater, hazardous and solid waste, as well as air pollution control, Versar said.
